quests.instruction: Look at the number and find the matching word!
quests.hint: Read the numeral 74 out loud -- what word do you say?
quests.explanation: The numeral 74 is written in words as "Seventy-Four" -- that's its name!
quests.funFact: In math, knowing how to read words like 'Seventy-Four' is just as important as knowing the digits!

quests.instruction: What number continues the pattern: 19, 29, 39, __?
quests.hint: Add the same jump size again to the last number in the pattern.
quests.explanation: Each number jumps up by 10, so after 39 comes 39 + 10 = 49!
quests.funFact: The number 49 is an odd number!

quests.instruction: Read the word and find the matching number!
quests.question: Forty-Two
quests.hint: Say the word out loud, then look for the matching numeral among the choices.
quests.explanation: "Forty-Two" is how we say the number 42 in English, so 42 is the digit that matches!
quests.funFact: If you count up by ones, 42 comes right after 41!

quests.instruction: Is 98 an odd number or an even number?
quests.hint: Look at the very last digit of 98 -- is it 0, 2, 4, 6, or 8?
quests.explanation: 98 can be split into two equal groups with nothing left over, so 98 is Even!
quests.funFact: Even numbers always end in 0, 2, 4, 6, or 8!

quests.instruction: Which number is the greatest: 40, 91, or 60?
quests.hint: Line all three numbers up in counting order first.
quests.explanation: Out of 40, 91, and 60, the number 91 is the greatest!
quests.funFact: If you count up by ones, 91 comes right after 90!

quests.instruction: What number continues the pattern: 17, 19, 21, __?
quests.hint: Add the same jump size again to the last number in the pattern.
quests.explanation: Each number jumps up by 2, so after 21 comes 21 + 2 = 23!
quests.funFact: If you count backwards, 23 comes just before 24!

quests.instruction: Look at the number and find the matching word!
quests.hint: Count up to 71 in your head, saying each number word as you go.
quests.explanation: The numeral 71 is written in words as "Seventy-One" -- that's its name!
quests.funFact: The word 'Seventy-One' helps us communicate numbers without just drawing shapes!

quests.instruction: What digit is in the tens place of 50?
quests.hint: Split 50 into its place-value parts, then find the tens part.
quests.explanation: In 50, the digit 5 sits in the tens place!
quests.funFact: Double 5 is 10! Because 5 + 5 = 10.

quests.instruction: Which number is greater: 68 or 55?
quests.question: 68 or 55
quests.hint: Picture counting all the way up -- whichever number you'd reach later is the answer.
quests.explanation: 68 is greater than 55 -- when counting up, 68 comes later!
quests.funFact: If you add 1 to 68, you get 69!

quests.instruction: What digit is in the tens place of 72?
quests.hint: Cover up every digit except the tens digit in 72.
quests.explanation: In 72, the digit 7 sits in the tens place!
quests.funFact: If you had 7 apples and found one more, you would have 8 apples!

quests.instruction: Which number is the greatest: 97, 66, or 85?
quests.hint: Compare them two at a time, then keep the bigger one.
quests.explanation: Out of 97, 66, and 85, the number 97 is the greatest!
quests.funFact: If you multiply 97 by 10, it becomes 970!

quests.instruction: What number continues the pattern: 27, 29, 31, __?
quests.hint: The pattern counts up by 2 each time. What comes after 31?
quests.explanation: Each number jumps up by 2, so after 31 comes 31 + 2 = 33!
quests.funFact: If you add 0 to 33, it stays exactly the same: 33!

quests.instruction: Is 98 an odd number or an even number?
quests.hint: Look at the very last digit of 98 -- is it 0, 2, 4, 6, or 8?
quests.explanation: 98 can be split into two equal groups with nothing left over, so 98 is Even!
quests.funFact: If a number is even, everybody gets a buddy!

quests.instruction: What number continues the pattern: 15, 20, 25, 30, __?
quests.hint: Add the same jump size again to the last number in the pattern.
quests.explanation: Each number jumps up by 5, so after 30 comes 30 + 5 = 35!
quests.funFact: The number 35 is an odd number!

quests.instruction: What digit is in the ones place of 94?
quests.hint: Count from the right: ones first, then tens, then hundreds -- find the ones spot.
quests.explanation: In 94, the digit 4 sits in the ones place!
quests.funFact: The number 4 is a single-digit number, meaning it only takes up one spot!

quests.instruction: Which number is smaller: 44 or 61?
quests.question: 44 or 61
quests.hint: Compare the digits from left to right: which number has more value?
quests.explanation: 44 is smaller than 61 -- when counting up, 44 comes earlier!
quests.funFact: If you count up by ones, 44 comes right after 43!

quests.instruction: Look at the number and find the matching word!
quests.hint: Look at how many digits 85 has, then think of how that word usually sounds.
quests.explanation: The numeral 85 is written in words as "Eighty-Five" -- that's its name!
quests.funFact: In math, knowing how to read words like 'Eighty-Five' is just as important as knowing the digits!

quests.instruction: Read the word and find the matching number!
quests.question: Seventy
quests.hint: Sound the word out slowly, then count that many fingers to check.
quests.explanation: "Seventy" is how we say the number 70 in English, so 70 is the digit that matches!
quests.funFact: If you count up by ones, 70 comes right after 69!

quests.instruction: Which number is greater: 96 or 84?
quests.question: 96 or 84
quests.hint: Line the numbers up on a number line in your head -- further right is bigger.
quests.explanation: 96 is greater than 84 -- when counting up, 96 comes later!
quests.funFact: Double 96 is 192! Because 96 + 96 = 192.

quests.instruction: What number continues the pattern: 6, 11, 16, 21, __?
quests.hint: Look at how much bigger each number is than the one before it -- that jump stays the same every time.
quests.explanation: Each number jumps up by 5, so after 21 comes 21 + 5 = 26!
quests.funFact: If you add 1 to 26, you get 27!

quests.instruction: Which number is the greatest: 100, 79, or 47?
quests.hint: The greatest number is the one you'd reach last while counting up from zero.
quests.explanation: Out of 100, 79, and 47, the number 100 is the greatest!
quests.funFact: Double 100 is 200! Because 100 + 100 = 200.

quests.instruction: Is 57 an odd number or an even number?
quests.hint: Count by twos (2, 4, 6, 8...) -- does 57 ever land exactly on one of those steps?
quests.explanation: 57 cannot be split into two equal groups -- there's always one left over, so 57 is Odd!
quests.funFact: If you try to split an odd number in half, you will always have one left over!

quests.instruction: Which number is the greatest: 90, 51, or 86?
quests.hint: Compare them two at a time, then keep the bigger one.
quests.explanation: Out of 90, 51, and 86, the number 90 is the greatest!
quests.funFact: If you multiply 90 by 10, it becomes 900!

quests.instruction: Which number is greater: 57 or 78?
quests.question: 57 or 78
quests.hint: Compare the digits from left to right: which number has more value?
quests.explanation: 78 is greater than 57 -- when counting up, 78 comes later!
quests.funFact: If you add 0 to 78, it stays exactly the same: 78!

quests.instruction: Read the word and find the matching number!
quests.question: Seventy-Five
quests.hint: Break the word into parts -- does it sound like a small number, a "teen", or a bigger one?
quests.explanation: "Seventy-Five" is how we say the number 75 in English, so 75 is the digit that matches!
quests.funFact: If you add 0 to 75, it stays exactly the same: 75!

quests.instruction: Look at the number and find the matching word!
quests.hint: Read the numeral 70 out loud -- what word do you say?
quests.explanation: The numeral 70 is written in words as "Seventy" -- that's its name!
quests.funFact: The word 'Seventy' helps us communicate numbers without just drawing shapes!

quests.instruction: What digit is in the ones place of 49?
quests.hint: Split 49 into its place-value parts, then find the ones part.
quests.explanation: In 49, the digit 9 sits in the ones place!
quests.funFact: The number 9 is a single-digit number, meaning it only takes up one spot!

quests.instruction: Read the word and find the matching number!
quests.question: Seventy-Four
quests.hint: Sound the word out slowly, then count that many fingers to check.
quests.explanation: "Seventy-Four" is how we say the number 74 in English, so 74 is the digit that matches!
quests.funFact: The number 74 has two digits: a 7 in the tens place and a 4 in the ones place!

quests.instruction: Look at the number and find the matching word!
quests.hint: Look at how many digits 43 has, then think of how that word usually sounds.
quests.explanation: The numeral 43 is written in words as "Forty-Three" -- that's its name!
quests.funFact: Did you know? The math word 'Forty-Three' is spelled with exactly 10 letters!

quests.instruction: Which number is the smallest: 73, 43, or 59?
quests.hint: The smallest number is the one you'd reach first while counting up from zero.
quests.explanation: Out of 73, 43, and 59, the number 43 is the smallest!
quests.funFact: If you count backwards, 43 comes just before 44!
